seed: Start from the transitions where an action produced no change at all. Find what blocked the action in each case and write the blocking condition before the movement rule.

synth.notes:
Word-edit game: cursor (player) snaps to editable glyph x slots.
ACTION3/4 = previous/next slot with wraparound (15->43 on ACTION3).
Blocking: ACTION1/2 edit the glyph but the schema has no pixels, so nothing visible changes; ACTION5-7 are no-ops too.
Legends, targets, glyphs and move_counter stay static (the counter never changes).
Unconfirmed: what ACTION1/2 actually do to glyphs; passes stateless.
